profile.summary: Reliance Infrastructure Limited, an infrastructure company, generates, transmits, and distributes electrical power to residential, industrial, commercial, and other consumers in India. It operates through three segments: Power; Engineering and Construction (E&C); and Infrastructure. The Power segment engages in the trading of power.
